final: WITH order_counts AS (SELECT a.account_id, COUNT(o.order_id) AS order_count FROM account AS a LEFT JOIN "order" AS o ON o.account_id = a.account_id GROUP BY a.account_id), overall AS (SELECT AVG(order_count) AS avg_order_count FROM order_counts), kept AS (SELECT oc.account_id, oc.order_count, oc.order_count - overall.avg_order_count AS above_overall_average FROM order_counts AS oc CROSS JOIN overall WHERE oc.order_count > overall.avg_order_count), kept_average AS (SELECT AVG(order_count) AS avg_kept_order_count FROM kept) SELECT kept.account_id, kept.order_count, kept.above_overall_average, kept.order_count - kept_average.avg_kept_order_count AS above_kept_average FROM kept CROSS JOIN kept_average ORDER BY above_kept_average DESC, kept.account_id LIMIT 10
